WinGet Slipstreamed into Windows Sandbox I've just automated a few things on top of this original work: https://www.aloneguid.uk/posts/2022/12/launch-windows-sandbox-with-winget-enabled/ 1. downloading the winget install packages if not already present (this folder then gets shared into the guest sandbox) - dodges github's 100MB max file size limitation since the msixbundle is 250MB 1. building a parameterized .wsb Sandbox Config file to avoid hard coding abolute paths which would make this whole bundle less portable 1. prompting for & installing common tools inside the sandbox (e.g. vscode, git for windows) 1. also sharing the hosts Downloads folder inside the sandbox for file transfer convenience ## Files and their involvement File | Description -|- host_driver.ps1 | this is the main script to be launched sandbox_side.ps1 | this gets called from inside the sandbox upon startup, to install winget, etc appx & msix| install packages for the winget binaries
find latest updates here: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/#install-winget-on-windows-sandbox ## Sandbox Config file docs https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/application-security/application-isolation/windows-sandbox/windows-sandbox-configure-using-wsb-file ","encoding":"utf-8"},"sandbox_side.ps1":{"filename":"sandbox_side.ps1","type":"application/x-msdos-program","language":"PowerShell","raw_url":"https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Beej126/5b29720ff77bb1967a592024b3ca8d8d/raw/914c1a6a818056fe0af2a3d4022478f8c4969a1b/sandbox_side.ps1","size":1684,"truncated":false,"content":"# from: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/#install-winget-on-windows-sandbox param ( [string]$desktopFolderName ) Write-host "Installing WinGet & dependencies..." Add-AppxPackage -verbose ~/Desktop/$desktopFolderName/Microsoft.VCLibs.x64.14.00.Desktop.appx Add-AppxPackage -verbose ~/Desktop/$desktopFolderName/Microsoft.UI.Xaml.2.8.x64.appx Add-AppxPackage -verbose ~/Desktop/$desktopFolderName/Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_8wekyb3d8bbwe.msixbundle function askMe([string] $ask, [ScriptBlock] $command) { $Host.UI.RawUI.FlushInputBuffer() echo "" echo "" $ask if ($Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown').Character -eq "y") { & $command } } winget install microsoft.powershell --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements winget install "Windows Terminal" --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements askMe "Install VSCode? (y/n)" { winget install -e --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode -i --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --source winget} askMe "Install Git? (y/n)" { winget install -e --id Git.Git -i --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --source winget} # https://serverfault.com/questions/1018220/how-do-i-install-an-app-from-windows-store-using-powershell/1111507#1111507 askMe "Install Microsoft Store? (y/n)" { cd $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads & "C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" clone "https://github.com/ergosteur/LTSC-Add-MicrosoftStore-MultiArch.git" cd "LTSC-Add-MicrosoftStore-MultiArch" ./Add-Store.cmd SC start wuauserv SC start bits SC start cryptsvc SC start trustedinstaller }
